subtitle: Diggers and Dealers dominates a heavy gold news day as drilling hits keep landing across the Goldfields
lead: Discovery Capital Partners' watchlist logged 31 confirmed announcements from 25 distinct names over the past 24 hours, with the Diggers and Dealers Mining Forum in Kalgoorlie driving a wave of investor decks from Ora Banda, Ramelius, Northern Star, Evolution, Black Cat Syndicate, Saturn Metals, Antipa, Minerals 260, Geopacific and Benz Mining, alongside a strong run of drilling news from Kalamazoo, Brightstar, Horizon Gold, Sunstone Metals, Torque Metals, Solstice Minerals and Gateway Mining.
watch_items: Saturn Metals' A$5 million Share Purchase Plan, underwritten by Petra Capital, opens 6 August 2026 and closes 21 August 2026 at A$0.40 per share, following on from Tranche One of the A$25 million placement due to complete 6 August 2026.

Corazon's Heads of Agreement with Dynamic Metals for 170km2 of tenure near Chalice is targeted for completion within 60 days, by 1 October 2026, subject to due diligence and a pre-emptive rights waiver from Mineral Resources Limited.
Toubani's first gold stream drawdown at Kobada is targeted by end of August 2026, with an updated Mineral Resource Estimate due by end of Q3 2026.
Kalamazoo's updated Mt Olympus Mineral Resource Estimate is targeted for Q4 2026, feeding an Ashburton Pre-Feasibility Study targeted for Q1 2027.
Assays are still pending at Sunstone's Bramaderos prospects (4 holes and 9 channels at Melonal, 1 hole at Copete, 1 hole plus 4 trenches at Porotillo) ahead of a December quarter resource update.
Solstice Minerals awaits assays from 12 diamond tails and more than 30 further RC holes at Nanadie.
Gateway Mining's 2,400-sample soil program across Glenburgh South's Errabiddy and Northern Shear Corridors is expected to take about four weeks, with results due later this quarter.
day_in_brief: Diggers and Dealers dominated the session, with a run of investor decks from major and mid-tier gold producers restating rather than resetting the market's picture: Ramelius held its ~525kozpa FY30 target and A$5.8 billion market capitalisation, Northern Star detailed KCGM's 27Mtpa hub and 42Moz group resource base across two separate presentations, Evolution flagged higher Mungari discovery spend (A$33 million) alongside a margin-focused strategy citing an FY26 cash flow margin of A$1,958/oz, and Ora Banda set FY27 guidance of 125,000 to 140,000oz gold at AISC of A$3,400/oz to A$3,600/oz with A$267.7 million cash on hand. Black Cat Syndicate, Saturn Metals, Geopacific, Antipa, Minerals 260 (two releases), Benz Mining (two releases), Patronus Resources, Nexus Minerals and Golden Horse Minerals rounded out the forum-linked disclosures, several explicitly restating prior study metrics without new figures. Away from the forum, drilling results stood out: Kalamazoo's 36m @ 16g/t Au from 181m (including a peak 1m at 241g/t Au) at Mt Olympus, Brightstar's 305.4m @ 1.82g/t Au intercept tripling interpreted tonalite thickness at Sandstone, Horizon Gold's high-grade hits across Kingfisher, Hawk and Swan at Gum Creek, Torque Metals' new lodes outside Paris resource limits, and Solstice Minerals' extension of Nanadie copper-gold mineralisation over 1.2km of strike. Corporate activity included Arika Resources completing a A$5.85 million placement tranche, Corazon's binding tenure acquisition flanking the Chalice Gold Project for up to A$3.5 million, Medallion Metals clearing final approvals for Ravensthorpe, and Toubani progressing Kobada construction ahead of a targeted stream drawdown. No quarterlies featured in the window.

summaries.heading: Ora Banda sets out DRIVE to 300 growth plan and FY27 guidance at Diggers and Dealers
summaries.body: Ora Banda's Diggers and Dealers deck reiterates its aspirational ~300kozpa target and details FY27 guidance of 125,000 to 140,000oz gold at AISC of A$3,400/oz to A$3,600/oz, with total FY27 capital guidance of A$425 million. The company reports A$267.7 million cash at 30 June 2026, nil debt and a A$200 million undrawn revolving credit facility, giving pro forma liquidity of about A$468 million. Combined nameplate mill capacity is targeted to reach 4.2Mtpa by FY29 as the new 3.0Mtpa mill (commissioning expected March quarter 2028) is built alongside the existing 1.2Mtpa Davyhurst plant, with about A$180 million earmarked for infrastructure upgrades over three years.

summaries.heading: Geopacific reprises Woodlark DFS case at Diggers and Dealers
summaries.body: Geopacific's Diggers and Dealers deck restates the May 2026 Woodlark DFS: a 12-year operation producing 1.1Moz gold (100koz average annual, 117koz peak) at 89.7% recovery, with an A$1.3 billion post-tax NPV8% and 50.6% post-tax IRR at A$5,500/oz gold, an 18-month payback and A$1,966/oz LOM AISC. Pre-production capital is put at A$535 million and total life of mine capital at A$592 million (A$485/oz capital intensity). Market capitalisation is A$87.1 million based on the A$0.027 close on 30 July 2026, with cash of A$7.5 million at 30 June 2026 and Deutsche Balaton and St Barbara holding 47% and 14% respectively.

summaries.heading: Horizon returns broad high grade hits at Kingfisher, Hawk and Swan, Gum Creek
summaries.body: Final assays from RC drilling at Horizon Gold's 100% owned Gum Creek Project have returned high grade intercepts at three prospects. Kingfisher, which hosts open cut and underground resources of 78,900oz and 113,500oz respectively, returned 23m @ 5.26g/t Au from 188m (including 15m @ 7.65g/t Au from 192m, hole KFRC038) and 45m @ 1.24g/t Au from 114m (including 3m @ 6.79g/t Au from 114m, hole KFRC042). Hawk extended mineralisation down dip with 12m @ 2.30g/t Au from 140m (including 6m @ 4.26g/t Au from 140m, hole HKRC026), while Swan returned 16m @ 1.84g/t Au from 45m (including 7m @ 3.03g/t Au from 46m, hole SBRC150). Follow up RC and diamond drilling is planned at all three prospects ahead of resource updates later in 2026, with these additions sitting outside the recently completed DFS.

summaries.heading: MI6 outlines next exploration phase at Bullabulling, targeting resource growth and 2028 production
summaries.body: Minerals 260 has set out its next exploration phase at the Bullabulling Gold Project (190Mt @ 1.0g/t Au for 6.2Moz), 25km west of Coolgardie, WA. Auger drilling has defined gold anomalies extending about 1km southeast from Kraken and 1.1km along strike from the newly acquired Endeavour prospect, where historical drilling includes 16m @ 1.3g/t Au from 47m and 1m @ 29.0g/t Au from 1m, though holes averaged only 74m deep. A separate ~1km anomaly has been confirmed north of Dicksons. First pass RC drilling is planned across both corridors, alongside regional exploration of the 1,160km² tenure package and a completed 26,000m grade control program at Phoenix, with the company targeting commencement of production in late 2028.

summaries.heading: Multi-hub gold producer presents growth platform at Diggers and Dealers
summaries.body: Black Cat Syndicate presented its multi-hub gold producer story, citing a total resource base of 2.5Moz Au @ 2.7g/t, FY26 production of 90,833oz (including 24,537oz of third-party production), A$105 million cash and liquid investments, and no debt as at 30 June 2026. Share price growth is quoted at 19% p.a. from IPO (20 cps in 2018) to 90 cps in 2026, implying a market capitalisation of A$656 million on 729 million shares. New high-grade discoveries at Regulus (1,528oz at 9.7g/t diluted) and Lynx (454oz at 3.0g/t diluted) support the Paulsens hub, while Coyote discovery drilling results are due November 2026.

summaries.heading: Minerals 260 presents Bullabulling gold project at Diggers and Dealers
summaries.body: Minerals 260 presented its 6.2Moz Bullabulling Gold Project to the Diggers and Dealers Mining Forum 2026. The company confirmed that all material assumptions underpinning the production targets and forecast financial information in its 8 July 2026 PFS announcement continue to apply and have not materially changed. The presentation does not disclose any new production, cost or financial figures beyond those already released in the PFS.

summaries.heading: Saturn reprises Apollo Hill PFS metrics at Diggers and Dealers
summaries.body: Saturn Metals' investor deck for Diggers and Dealers restates the Apollo Hill heap leach project: a 2.83Moz Au Mineral Resource, a maiden 1.59Moz Au Ore Reserve, and a PFS NPV(8%) of A$973 million on a 1.77Moz production target over a 14 year mine life. Market capitalisation is A$229.9 million (A$0.42 per share) against enterprise value of A$189.5 million, implying EV/Resource ounce of A$67. The company reiterates the placement announced 29 July 2026, with Tranche One of A$25 million due to complete 6 August 2026, and points to a DFS and reserve upgrade targeted for CY2026 ahead of first gold in 2029.

summaries.heading: Antipa presents Paterson Province portfolio at Diggers and Dealers
summaries.body: Antipa Minerals used its Diggers and Dealers Mining Forum slide deck to restate its position as 100% owner of a dominant Paterson Province landholding, anchored by the stand-alone Minyari Dome gold-copper development project. The presentation points back to the October 2024 Scoping Study Update as the current basis for Minyari's development potential, with the company stating it holds no new information that materially changes those assumptions. No new figures or study results were disclosed.

summaries.heading: Kalamazoo hits bonanza-grade gold feeder zone at Mt Olympus, Ashburton
summaries.body: Kalamazoo has returned 36m @ 16g/t Au from 181m, including 10m @ 49g/t Au from 202m (with a peak 1m at 241g/t Au), in KARCD0146 at the 100% owned Mt Olympus deposit, Ashburton Gold Project. A second hole, KARC0145, returned 74m @ 4.1g/t Au from 144m including 17m @ 8.3g/t Au from 144m. Across the 20 holes reported, 15 intersections exceeded 50 gram-metres, including five above 100 gram-metres, with mineralisation extending beyond the current Mineral Resource but inside the Scoping Study pit shell. The 72-hole, 13,726m Resource Definition program is now complete, with assays received from 43 of 72 holes; results will feed an updated Mt Olympus Mineral Resource Estimate targeted for Q4 2026 and the Ashburton Pre-Feasibility Study targeted for Q1 2027. Underground Growth drilling beneath Mt Olympus and further drilling at Peake are underway.

summaries.heading: Sunstone extends Porotillo mineralisation over 520m x 230m outside Bramaderos resource
summaries.body: All 24 holes drilled at the Porotillo, Copete and Melonal prospects at Bramaderos have returned long mineralised intersections, none of which sit within the existing 3.6Moz Au-Eq resource. The latest four Porotillo holes include PTDD017 with 196m at 0.62g/t Au-Eq (0.35g/t Au, 0.16% Cu) from surface, and PTDD016 with 39.90m at 0.51g/t Au-Eq within a broader 128.92m intersection. Combined trenches PO-5 and PO-6 now span 608m at 0.52g/t Au-Eq. Assays remain pending for 4 holes and 9 channels at Melonal, one hole at Copete, and one hole plus 4 trenches at Porotillo, with results due in August ahead of a December quarter resource update. A 1,200m deep hole targeting the Limon porphyry system is set to begin in early August.

summaries.heading: Investor deck reiterates cash backing and 2.3Moz AuEq resource base ahead of Diggers and Dealers
summaries.body: Patronus Resources has released its Diggers and Dealers 2026 presentation, summarising a corporate position of $65 million in cash and investments against a $64 million market capitalisation, giving a negative enterprise value of $1 million. The company holds 2.3Moz AuEq in Mineral Resources across the Pine Creek project in the Northern Territory and the Cardinia project in Western Australia, with 1,479 million shares on issue and a share price of $0.043. A 30,000m multi-rig drilling campaign is underway at Pine Creek, with follow-up programmes at Fountain Head, Northern Leases, Burnside North, Golden Dyke and Grove Hill flagged through to December 2026.

summaries.heading: Ramelius reiterates 525koz p.a. FY30 growth plan at Diggers and Dealers
summaries.body: Ramelius' Diggers and Dealers presentation consolidates previously disclosed guidance rather than adding new figures. The company reaffirms a long-term production target of ~525koz p.a. by FY30 with 7.5Mtpa total mill capacity, an average AISC guidance of A$1,995/oz over the next five years, and free cash flow of over A$1 billion p.a. from FY30 at A$4,500/oz. It also restates FY26 exploration spend of A$7.0M at Penny, A$16.8M at Break of Day and Lena, A$23.0M at Galaxy and A$14.3M at Gilbeys, alongside a FY27 exploration budget of A$100 million. Market capitalisation is shown at A$5.8 billion based on the 30 July 2026 closing price of A$3.07, with cash and gold of A$650 million and an undrawn A$500 million debt facility as at 30 June 2026.

summaries.heading: Deep hole triples interpreted tonalite thickness at Two Mile Hill-Shillington
summaries.body: Brightstar Resources has returned 305.4m @ 1.82g/t Au from 351.9m (TMHRCD26020) at the Two Mile Hill-Shillington deposit, part of the 2.9Moz @ 1.3g/t Au Sandstone Gold Project, including 17.5m @ 9.68g/t Au from 351.9m (with 1.1m @ 103g/t Au) and 34.6m @ 4.11g/t Au from 586.7m (with 1.5m @ 46.7g/t Au). The hole ended in mineralised tonalite at 657.3m, lifting the interpreted thickness of the host intrusion to more than 180m from a prior 60m estimate. Infill drilling within the current 14.6Mt @ 1.6g/t Au for 731koz Au resource also returned 205m @ 2.67g/t Au from 293m (TMHRCD26009) and 197.7m @ 1.14g/t Au from 263.5m (TMHRCD26007). Four rigs remain active at Sandstone, with an updated Mineral Resource Estimate targeted before the end of 2026.

summaries.heading: New RC results extend Nanadie copper-gold mineralisation well beyond current resource
summaries.body: Nine of ten new RC holes at the 100%-owned Nanadie project in WA's Goldfields returned significant copper-gold intercepts, including 51m @ 1.03% Cu, 0.29g/t Au from 194m (NANRC041) and 97m @ 0.57% Cu, 0.16g/t Au from 173m (NANRC038). Mineralisation now extends over approximately 1.2km of strike, beyond the existing Inferred Mineral Resource of 40.4Mt at 0.4% Cu and 0.1g/t Au (162,000t copper, 130,000oz gold). Assays are pending from 12 diamond tails and more than 30 further RC holes, with Solstice holding approximately A$45 million cash and no debt to fund continued drilling.

summaries.heading: Golden Horse presents at Diggers and Dealers 2026
summaries.body: Golden Horse Minerals has lodged the investor presentation to be delivered by Managing Director and CEO Nicholas Anderson at the Diggers and Dealers Mining Forum in Kalgoorlie on Tuesday 4 August 2026 at 11:35am (AWST). The forum runs from 3 to 5 August 2026, with attendance available in person or via a free livestream requiring registration. No new operational or financial figures are disclosed beyond the presentation's release.

summaries.heading: Evolution lifts Mungari discovery spend, points to underground growth targets
summaries.body: A site visit presentation on Mungari Operations outlines a strategy to grow high-grade underground production, with FY27 discovery spend at Mungari increased to $33 million. The district holds a 650km2 tenement package, 7.2Moz (180Mt) Mineral Resource and 2.1Moz (47Mt) Ore Reserve, with 2.9Moz of Inferred Resources seen as conversion potential. Resource discovery cost since the 2021 Kundana acquisition is put at $23/oz (A$93 million). Growth targets for FY27 include underground drilling at Barkers and Star Trek, alongside recent results at Genesis and Arctic including ARDD25019 1.15m ETW at 44.03g/t Au from 197.56m.

summaries.heading: Nexus presents at Diggers and Dealers with A$5.3 million cash and Wallbrook development progress
summaries.body: Nexus Minerals used its Diggers and Dealers conference slot to lay out corporate metrics and project status rather than release new results. The company reports 603.8 million shares on issue, a share price of A$0.041, market capitalisation of A$24.7 million, cash of A$5.3 million as at 30 June 2026 and enterprise value of A$19.5 million. The Crusader-Templar deposit at Wallbrook carries a combined resource of 5,670kt at 1.7g/t Au for 304koz (140koz indicated, 164koz inferred), with permitting largely approved and a non-binding MOU with Macro Gold Mining Services covering funding, mine design and an ore purchase agreement. Progress on third-party toll treatment discussions is the next milestone to watch.

summaries.heading: Corazon secures 170km2 of tenure flanking Chalice Gold Project for up to A$3.5 million
summaries.body: Corazon has signed a binding Heads of Agreement with Dynamic Metals to acquire 100% of E15/1802 and gold rights over adjoining tenements E15/1705 and E15/1721, covering 170km2 and extending its footprint along 40km of prospective strike either side of the existing Chalice Mining Lease and its 191koz @ 2.7g/t Au resource. Consideration totals up to A$3.5 million (A$500,000 cash and A$1.0 million in escrowed shares upfront, plus two A$1.0 million milestone payments tied to resource growth to 150,000oz and 300,000oz Au) plus a 1.5% net smelter return royalty. Completion is targeted within 60 days, by 1 October 2026, subject to due diligence and a pre-emptive rights waiver from Mineral Resources Limited, ahead of Phase 1 resource growth drilling at Chalice targeted for Q3 CY2026.

summaries.heading: New high-grade lodes found outside existing Paris Gold Project resource limits
summaries.body: Torque Metals' first extensional diamond holes at the Observation and HHH deposits, part of its 100%-owned Paris Gold Project in WA, have hit new mineralisation outside current Mineral Resource boundaries. Observation returned 2.7m @ 5.20g/t Au from 201.2m (26ODD004), including 0.4m @ 29.97g/t Au, roughly 60m down-dip of the 25koz Au deposit. HHH delivered 1.0m @ 20.90g/t Au from 253.13m (26HDD005), including 0.6m @ 33.76g/t Au, about 70m down-plunge from its 73koz at 2.0g/t Au resource, plus 2.0m @ 2.39g/t Au from 220m (26HRC130). A new DHEM conductor identified below the HHH intercept gives a follow-up target, with the company citing a greater than 90% historic correlation between DHEM plates and gold mineralisation at Paris. Further drilling continues at both deposits and at the Paris deposit targeting a possible third lode (PL3).

summaries.heading: DFS-level metallurgical testwork confirms 98% to 99% gold recovery at Kookynie Gold Project
summaries.body: Carnavale Resources reports Definitive Feasibility Study level metallurgical testwork on the Kookynie Gold Project (60km south of Leonora, WA) has returned gold recoveries of 98% (oxide), 98% (intermediate) and 99% (fresh) at a 106-micron grind, using cyanidation leach testwork conducted with process water sourced from a Goldfields CIL operation. Gravity recoveries ranged 71% to 81%, cyanide consumption was low at 0.35kg/t to 0.44kg/t, and testwork found no preg-robbing, refractory mineralisation or deleterious elements across the oxide, transitional and fresh domains. Tailings characterisation is ongoing, and the company is now seeking a toll treatment or ore purchase agreement given the project relies on third-party processing.

summaries.heading: Benz details maiden 10.1 to 12Moz Glenburgh exploration target by camp
summaries.body: Benz Mining's Diggers & Dealers presentation breaks down the previously reported Glenburgh Exploration Target of 485 to 540Mt at 0.6 to 0.7g/t Au for 10.1 to 12Moz across three camps. Hurricane's drill-constrained higher-grade core is 25 to 28Mt at 2.50 to 2.72g/t Au (2.0 to 2.5Moz), Icon's is 54 to 60Mt at 1.40 to 1.47g/t Au (2.4 to 2.8Moz), while Thunderbolt's drill-constrained portion is only 3.07 to 3.41Mt at 1.40 to 1.55g/t Au (0.1 to 0.2Moz) with a further 16 to 17Mt conceptual projection at the same grade for 0.7 to 0.9Moz. The company reports metallurgical recoveries of over 95% CIL gold recovery from Icon test work, with the A$75 million raise from February 2026 funding studies toward a maiden Mineral Resource Estimate targeted for CY27.

summaries.heading: New high-grade hinge zones emerge as drilling tightens at Icon, Glenburgh
summaries.body: Infill drilling on Benz's baseline 50m by 25m pattern at the Icon deposit, Glenburgh Gold Project, has identified new NE-plunging high-grade fold hinges within the existing footprint, including 41m at 14.5g/t Au from 260m in 26CN079, 75m at 2.3g/t Au from 253m in 26CN064, 39m at 3.6g/t Au from 186m (including 8m at 15.6g/t Au from 192m) in 26CN074, and 62m at 2.5g/t Au from 179m within a broader 102m at 1.7g/t Au in 26CN073. Benz says the same NE-plunging hinge architecture mirrors that seen at the Hurricane camp and is proving a repeatable driver of ounce growth. The next phase will complete baseline drilling across Hurricane, Icon and Thunderbolt ahead of a maiden resource targeted for H1 2027.

summaries.heading: Evolution reiterates margin-focused strategy at Diggers and Dealers, not price sensitive
summaries.body: Evolution Mining's Diggers and Dealers presentation frames the company as a margin-focused gold and copper producer, citing an FY26 record group cash flow margin of A$1,958/oz and an 18% ROI on assets acquired since 2015. The company reports a portfolio Ore Reserve mine life of ~17 years based on 12Moz of Ore Reserves as at 31 December 2025 against FY26 gold production of 715koz, and points to more than A$2 billion in total dividends paid across 26 consecutive dividends. Growth optionality is centred on Ernest Henry (including the Carnaby Resources acquisition, the Bert underground mine and Corella) and Northparkes (E22 block cave and a plant expansion study to lift milling capacity by 40 to 100%).

summaries.heading: Northern Star details KCGM 27Mtpa hub and district growth strategy at Diggers & Dealers
summaries.body: Northern Star's Diggers and Dealers presentation frames KCGM as a 27Mtpa processing hub underpinning 42Moz of Mineral Resources and 15Moz of Ore Reserves, with the company targeting a significant reduction in processing cost per tonne at steady state versus FY26, expected from FY29. Group-wide, Northern Star reports total Mineral Resources of 1,617,472,000 tonnes at 1.7g/t for 88,872,000 ounces and total Ore Reserves of 627,210,000 tonnes at 1.4g/t for 28,419,000 ounces as at 31 March 2026. The district tenement package covers 1,543km2 around Kalgoorlie, with the company citing A$17/oz as the cost of KCGM Mineral Resource additions over the past five years. Planned energy inputs include a 256MW wind farm, 110MW solar farm, 120MW multi-fuel thermal power station and a 138/300MWh battery storage system.

summaries.heading: Northern Star details KCGM's 27Mtpa expansion and 42Moz resource base at investor site visit
summaries.body: Northern Star hosted an investor site visit presentation on KCGM, reporting Mineral Resources of 42Moz (1,617,472,000 tonnes at 1.7g/t) and Ore Reserves of 15Moz (627,210,000 tonnes at 1.4g/t) for the total NST group as at 31 March 2026. KCGM Operations alone hold 42,191,000 ounces of Mineral Resources and 14,997,000 ounces of Ore Reserves. The Fimiston processing plant is being expanded to 27Mtpa, with early September tie-in of new 18Mtpa infrastructure alongside the retained 9Mtpa circuit, and steady state processing cost reductions are targeted from FY29. KCGM open pit inventory stands at 18Moz Mineral Resources (429Mt at 1.3g/t) and 8Moz Ore Reserves (182Mt at 1.4g/t), while Fimiston Underground carries a 35Mt Ore Reserve at 2.2g/t for 2.5Moz, with only 1Mt mined in FY26.

summaries.heading: Kobada construction progresses as Toubani prepares first gold stream drawdown
summaries.body: Toubani reports process plant and infrastructure work underway at the Kobada Gold Project, with the water storage dam and turkey's nest complete, the airstrip 65% finished and over 500 tons of structural steel fabricated. CIL tank ring beam construction has commenced and the mining contractor Corica Mining Services S.A. is being mobilised for pre-production activities. Following completion of the gold stream agreement and strategic equity financing, first drawdown under the stream is targeted by the end of August 2026, with an updated Mineral Resource Estimate due by the end of Q3 and first gold production targeted for the third quarter of calendar year 2027.

summaries.heading: Gateway begins 2,400-sample soil program across Glenburgh South structural corridors
summaries.body: Gateway Mining has commenced regional soil sampling across the Errabiddy and Northern Shear Corridors at its Glenburgh South Project, targeting structural repeats of Benz Mining Corp's Tier 1 Glenburgh gold discovery. The program covers over 2,400 samples across approximately 50km of prospective corridors (25km of the 50km Errabiddy Target being tested now, plus the 25km Northern Shear Corridor), following delays from wet season rainfall. Sampling is expected to take about four weeks, with results due later this quarter. Gateway held A$15.1 million in cash and liquid securities at the end of the June 2026 quarter.

summaries.heading: Ravensthorpe Gold Project clears final regulatory hurdles
summaries.body: Medallion Metals has secured the last approvals needed to develop its Ravensthorpe Gold Project, with the Mining Development and Closure Plan and the Section 45C amendment to Ministerial Statement 1143 both approved. All statutory approvals are now in place to begin development, including underground mine development at the Kundip Mining Centre and refurbishment of the Cosmic Boy Concentrator. The Early Production Strategy remains on track for Q3 CY2026, with first Ravensthorpe ore to the Cosmic Boy Concentrator targeted for Q2 CY2027.

summaries.heading: Arika completes Tranche 1 placement, raising A$5.85 million
summaries.body: Arika Resources has completed Tranche 1 of its placement announced 27 July 2026, raising A$5.85 million before costs via 307,894,737 fully paid ordinary shares at A$0.019 each, issued to new and existing institutional and sophisticated investors. The shares were issued under existing Listing Rule 7.1 and 7.1A capacity (184,529,728 and 123,365,009 shares respectively) and rank equally with existing shares on issue. A cleansing notice under section 708A(5)(e) accompanies the issue.

summaries.heading: Saturn Metals' Share Purchase Plan underwritten by Petra Capital
summaries.body: Saturn Metals has updated its Share Purchase Plan announcement to confirm Petra Capital will underwrite the offer for up to A$5 million, with no fee payable for acting as underwriter. The SPP offers shares at A$0.40 each, with applications between A$1,000 and A$30,000 per holder, opening 6 August 2026 and closing 21 August 2026. Funds raised are earmarked for front end engineering and design, procurement of long lead items, construction readiness and exploration drilling at Apollo Hill.

summaries.heading: Saturn Metals' A$5 million SPP fully underwritten by Petra Capital
summaries.body: Following its A$100 million placement, Saturn Metals has secured underwriting from Petra Capital for the full A$5 million targeted under its Share Purchase Plan. Eligible AU/NZ shareholders can apply for up to A$30,000 worth of shares at A$0.40 each, with the SPP opening on 6 August 2026 and closing 21 August 2026. Proceeds go towards early-stage development at the Apollo Hill Gold Project.
